'''June 2001 Raleigh tournament (9 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Foundation's Edge, Raleigh, NC on 9 June 2001. Jim Achooie-Kachooie (joke surname in the report) won it. It is known from Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2425">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01d2425/ raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 9 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01d2425/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Foundation's Edge, Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' Jim Achooie-Kachooie (joke surname in the report)
